metadata.operation: Actual same-directory os.Rename(value.go, renamed.go) and reverse; source bytes and Go package unchanged.
metadata.transport: Filesystem-only lower bound, plus production MCP server over in-process JSON-RPC pipes with real external gopls.
metadata.continuity_policy: Warm MCP cases abort on the first unexpected restart; no warm p99 is emitted for a failed continuity case.
metadata.budget_enforcement: Latency budgets report-only; session continuity and correct observable state are mandatory.

outcome: Filesystem lower bounds measured; all four warm MCP cases rejected on the first gopls restart.

mcp.meaning: Single observed rename/reaction before the continuity guard aborted the case; not a percentile.

limitations: There is no dedicated Go file-rename MCP operation; the benchmark uses an external os.Rename followed by a production MCP reaction.
Only ordinary same-directory Go filenames are covered; package changes and build-selection-changing names are excluded.
The filesystem p99 values use 1,000 samples per fixture; failed MCP cases provide one observation each and no warm percentile.
Lookup synchronization occurs outside the primary timed sample and is checked to expose deferred process invalidation.
Synthetic one-package and twenty-package fixtures, production MCP over in-process pipes, and the configured real gopls build.
No runtime restart policy changes are included in this benchmark addition.
